name: io.github.tonyyang0504/yahoo_japan_ads-mcp
description: LINEヤフー広告 (formerly Yahoo! JAPAN Ads) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, update_budget, pause

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_JAPAN_ADS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your approved LINEヤフー広告 API application (API管理ツール).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_JAPAN_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from one authorization-code login with a Business ID (scope yahooads, https://ads-developers.yahoo.co.jp/ja/ads-api/startup-guide/api-call.html); valid until the user revokes the app. One-hour access tokens are minted from it.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_JAPAN_ADS_BASE_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Account the Business ID directly holds rights on (MCC or ad account id from BaseAccountService/get), sent as the x-z-base-account-id header on every call.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_JAPAN_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Search ad account id used by update_budget and pause_resume (CampaignService/set requires accountId in the body).
